claims.claim: MPNet combines masked and permuted pretraining to model dependencies among target tokens while utilizing full position information.
claims.verification_note: Contrasts MLM output dependency and XLNet position discrepancy.

claims.claim: Position compensation adds [M] with positions of predicted tokens to the nonpredicted part.
claims.verification_note: Position placeholders are not revealed true target words.

claims.claim: Two-stream attention allows later predicted tokens to condition on earlier targets without leaking the current target.
claims.verification_note: Contrasts independent MLM target loss with target autoregression.

claims.claim: Under the paper's 15 percent target assumption the information-coverage analysis reports 100 percent position information for MPNet and 92.5 percent for PLM.
claims.verification_note: Metric is analytic position coverage, not accuracy or benchmark score.

claims.claim: MPNet ablation studies separately remove position compensation, permutation and output dependency.
claims.verification_note: No unqualified mixture of task metrics or splits.

claims.claim: MPNet pretraining objective and downstream sentence embedding fine-tuning are distinct training stages.
claims.locator: Abstract; pretraining and downstream GLUE/SQuAD evaluations
claims.verification_note: NeurIPS paper evaluates language understanding; not an automatic claim about later retrieval-specific checkpoints.
